stories.title: Hackers Return $263 Million Stolen From Liquid Network
stories.description: Alleged ‘white-hat’ hackers drained $320 million from Liquid’s federation wallet, demanding a bug fix.

stories.title: CISA Warns of Chromium Type Confusion 0-Day Vulnerability Actively Exploited in Attacks
stories.description: CISA has added a critical Google Chromium V8 type confusion vulnerability, tracked as CVE-2026-85046, to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) Catalog, warning that the flaw is being actively exploited in attacks.

stories.title: Slim Spider Steals Crypto Custody Secrets From Brazilian Financial Institution
stories.description: Slim Spider attacks Brazilian financial firms, stealing cloud credentials and crypto custody secrets while targeting Pix payment infrastructure.

stories.title: Ivanti EPMM, Neurons and Sentry Vulnerabilities Enable Privilege Escalation and RCE Attacks
stories.description: Ivanti has disclosed a wave of security advisories affecting three flagship enterprise products, Endpoint Manager Mobile, Neurons for ITSM, and Sentry, exposing organizations to risks ranging from privilege escalation to full remote code execution.

stories.title: Dell Secure Connect Gateway Vulnerabilities Allow Hackers to Gain Unauthorized Access
stories.description: Dell Discloses Three Critical Secure Connect Gateway Flaws Enabling Remote Command Execution and Root Access.

stories.title: Cylake Raises $245 Million Ahead of Cybersecurity Platform Beta
stories.description: The startup founded by Palo Alto Networks’ Nir Zuk has raised $290 million to build an AI-native security platform for highly regulated organizations that cannot rely on the public cloud.

stories.title: ChatGPT Sandbox Flaw Lets Attackers Steal Gmail Data Across Accounts via Hidden Channel
stories.description: Check Point Research has uncovered a covert cross-account communication channel inside ChatGPT that allowed an attacker to hijack a victim's session and silently exfiltrate data from connected apps like Gmail, all while the victim saw nothing unusual in…

stories.title: SAP Patches Critical Extended Passport Processing Vulnerability
stories.description: Affecting the SAP kernel code, the flaw allows unauthenticated, remote attackers to run arbitrary commands, recover secrets, and modify data.

stories.title: Liquid Hackers Return 3,400 Bitcoin Taken via Elements Bug, Still Holding $47M in BTC
stories.description: Liquid received 3,400 bitcoin back after nearly 4,000 BTC was taken; 598.5 BTC remains unreturned and the network is still paused.

stories.title: ChatGPT Flaw Let a Planted Prompt Send a Victim's Gmail Data to Another Account
stories.description: A planted ChatGPT instruction could read connected Gmail data and relay it across accounts through shared Artifactory metadata.

stories.title: Autonomous AI Agents Compromise Thousands of Credentials in Under Six Hours
stories.description: A financially motivated actor used an autonomous multi-agent framework to compromise thousands of third-party credentials in under six hours.

stories.title: Party’s Over for Crypto Scammers Who Went on a Spending Spree After a $240 Million Bitcoin Theft
stories.description: The scammers purchased fleets of sports cars, flew on private jets, hired security guards and rented mansions in Miami and the Hamptons.

stories.title: Microsoft Plugs Nearly 400 Security Holes
stories.description: Microsoft today released updates to remedy at least 398 security vulnerabilities in its Windows operating systems and supported software, including one weakness that is already being actively exploited and two others that were publicly detailed prior to today.
